read_image_or_flow_file: read a .png, .jpg, .flo, .pfm, or .float3 file and return the numpy array data
write_image_or_flow_file: write numpy array data to a .png, .jpg, .flo, .pfm, or .float3 file by extension
readPFM_parse_portable_floatmap: read a PFM file and return the float32 image data and scale factor
writePFM_save_portable_floatmap: write a float32 numpy array as a PFM file with optional scale factor
readFlow_parse_optical_flow: read a .flo optical flow file and return the float32 flow field array
